name: Standard Lobe
description: The standard lobe piercing is done near the bottom of the ear lobe

name: Nostril
description: A nostril piercing typically sits on the side of the nostril, often near the natural crease for a classic look

name: Stacked lobe
description: A stacked lobe is done by multiple piercings placed closely together on the earlobe, often in a vertical line or artistic pattern. Ideal for styling with rings and/ore tiny studs.

name: Eyebrow
description: Eyebrow piercing positions vary but typically involve the vertical eyebrow (most common, angled through the outer brow) or horizontal placement, with options like the center eyebrow or anti-eyebrow (below the eye)

name: Tragus
description: A tragus piercing goes through the small, firm cartilage flap (the tragus) in front of the ear canal

name: Labret
description: A side labret piercing is placed off-center on the lower lip, either to the left or right

name: Helix
description: A helix piercing is a ear cartilage piercing located on the upper, outer rim of the ear

name: Cheek
description: A cheek piercing, also called a dimple piercing, is placed where natural dimples form, mimicking them.

name: Upper Helix
description: An upper helix piercing, often called a Bugadi, is placed on the outer rim of the upper ear cartilage, following its natural curve, and can vary in exact spots (mid-helix, near the top) for single or stacked looks (double/triple)
